name: Chloe Bennett
occupation: Graphic designer working from a home studio
psychographics: Prioritizes sustainability and minimizing waste. Hates the idea of driving 20 miles just to buy one item, but struggles to trust delivery services with fresh produce.
current_solutions: Uses the local farm's WhatsApp group to organize a weekly box of vegetables. For pantry staples, she cycles to the village shop when she has energy.
frustration: Two weeks ago, she ordered a delivery of organic carrots from a national app; the driver left the box on a muddy path 2 miles from her house during a rainstorm, and the carrots arrived rotten. She now refuses to use that service for fresh items.
decision_style: Researches veg box schemes for weeks, then cancels at the last minute if the price per kilo goes over £1.50, sticking to her trusted local farmer instead.
voice: Fast-paced and informal, heavy on current slang and abbreviations; switches to formal ' Received Pronunciation' when complaining about a service failure.
